name_input: SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; THE SUKHJIT AGRO INDUSTRIES; THE SUKHJIT AGRO IND.; THE SUKHJIT STARCH AND CHEMICALS LTD; SUKHJIT CORN PRODUCTS ( A UNIT OF THE SUKHJIT STARCH AND CHEMICALS LIMITED); SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; SUKHJIT STARCH INDUSTRIES
export_evidence: No shipment record retrieved. importkey.com/countries/india/sukhjit-starch-and-chemicals-ltd and .../sukhjit-starch-chemicals-ltd both returned only a gated shell: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." — zero rows visible (0 of 0). volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and importgenius.com all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code could be read from any free source.
domestic_evidence: Corporate site (sukhjitgroup.com) confirms the legal entity and four operating plants: "Sukhjit Corn Products Rehana Jattan, Teh. Phagwara, (Punjab) ... Sukhjit Starch Mills Nizamabad, (Telengana) ... Sukhjit Starch Industries Malda, (West Bengal) ... Sukhjit Agro Industries Gurplah, Dist. UNA (Himachal Pradesh)" — this is a company self-description, not a supply record. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report revenue split could be opened: the Annual Report page lists only year labels ("Annual Report Year 2026 ... Year 2010") with no retrievable document links, and the Financial Highlights page returned no figures.
note: Legal entity THE SUKHJIT STARCH AND CHEMICALS LIMITED is real and operating (listed, Phagwara, Kapurthala, Punjab; the other names in the batch are its units/brands, not separate legal persons). Declared HS 110812 (maize/corn starch) and 290544 (sorbitol) match the published product list ("Maize Starch", "Sorbitol 70%"), so no HS correction is needed. However, per Rule 5 no actual shipment evidence was obtained in either direction: all trade-data platforms were paywalled or blocked and web_search was unavailable (connection refused), so export_status is unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source I could open; not estimated. No traces of supply could be verified, but this reflects source access failure, not a finding of absence — recommend re-checking with a paid Volza/Eximpedia view or the FY annual report PDF before any verdict.
